replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to reduce the dimensionality of data. You start by standardizing the data, then compute the covariance matrix. Next, you find the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the covariance matrix.
